blocks.text: Explanation:- The respected Ulama have written another explanation of this Hadith: “Whoever does not, by virtue of the Holy Qur'an, come to a state of not needing people is not of us”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا أَذِنَ اللهُ لِشَيْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ حَسَنِ الصَّوْتِ يَتَغَنَّي بِالْقُرْآنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب استحباب تحسين الصوت بالقرآن رقم:١٨٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah does not listen attentively to the voice of others as He listens attentively to the voice of a Prophet reciting the Holy Qur'an in a sweet voice”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: زَيِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْتَ الْحَسَنَ يَزِيدُ الْقُرْآنَ حُسْناً.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Beautify the recitation of the Qur'an with a sweet voice, for a sweet voice increases the beauty of the recitation of the Qur'an”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: الْجَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ كَالْجَاهِرِ بِالصَّدَقَةِ وَالْمُسِرُّ بِالْقُرْآنِ كَالْمُسِرِّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب من قرا القران فليسال الله به رقم:٢٩١٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “One who recites the Noble Qur'an aloud is like one who gives Sadaqah openly, and one who recites it silently is like one who gives Sadaqah secretly”.

blocks.text: Explanation:- From this Hadith it is understood that reciting quietly is better; however, this is when there is a fear that showing off (Riya) may arise
